title: HubMap UF TMC Tissue Dissociation to Single Cell
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd9vi966

steps.title: Prepare ammonium chloride buffer
steps.instruction: Add 8.02 g NH₄Cl, 0.84 g NaHCO₃, and 5 µL of 0.5 M EDTA to 1000 mL deionized water.

steps.title: Filter and aliquot buffer
steps.instruction: Pass the buffer through a 22 µm PES filter, aliquot into 50 mL conical tubes, and store at room temperature for long‑term use.

steps.title: Prepare complete DMEM media
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 10 mL Penicillin/Streptomycin to 440 mL DMEM.

steps.title: Collect tissue sample and keep on ice
steps.instruction: Obtain a 1 cm × 1 cm × 1 cm tissue cube (thymus, spleen, or lymph node) and place it in a 15 mL conical tube containing 5 mL cold DMEM (cDMEM); keep on ice.

steps.title: Filter tissue suspension and store cold
steps.instruction: Pass the tissue suspension through a filter flask and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Make collagenase digest solution
steps.instruction: Combine 1 mL of 10× Collagenase/Hyaluronidase (in DMEM) with 9 mL DMEM containing 5 % FBS to obtain 10 mL digest mix; warm to 37 °C in a water bath.

steps.title: Mince tissue into ~2 mm pieces
steps.instruction: Using two scalpels, mince the tissue crosswise in a sterile petri dish until fragments are approximately 2 mm in all dimensions.

steps.title: Incubate tissue fragments with digest
steps.instruction: Transfer minced fragments to a C tube, add the 10 mL digest mix, and incubate at 37 °C in a shaking incubator for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Run gentleMACS dissociation program
steps.instruction: Place the C tube on the gentleMACS dissociator and run protocol mspln0201.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension and wash with DMEM
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a 50 mL conical tube placed over a 500 µm mesh filter; wash the filter with DMEM until the tube is full, then centrifuge at 350 × g for 10 minutes, starting at room temperature and then cooling to 8 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge, resuspend, and filter through 100 µm mesh
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in cold cDMEM, decant the suspension over a 100 µm filter into a new conical tube, and centrifuge at 350 × g for 10 minutes at 8 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge, resuspend, and filter through 40 µm mesh
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 10 mL cold HBSS, decant over a 40 µm filter into a new conical tube, and keep the filtrate on ice while proceeding to cell counting.

steps.title: Take aliquot for viability counting
steps.instruction: Withdraw a 20 µL aliquot of the cell suspension for counting on a Nexcelom Cellometer.

steps.title: Stain aliquot with Viastain AO/PI and count
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Viastain AO/PI to the 20 µL aliquot, mix thoroughly with a pipette, place 20 µL on a counting slide, and count using the “immune cells low RBC” setting with a dilution factor of 2.0; record total yield and viability.

steps.title: Pellet remaining cells and resuspend in Cryostor
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the remaining cell suspension at 350 × g for 10 minutes at 8 °C, discard the supernatant, gently dissociate the pellet, and resuspend dropwise in Cryostor 10 at a concentration of 25 × 10⁶ cells / mL.

steps.title: Cryopreserve cells in CoolCell and transfer to -80 °C
steps.instruction: Aliquot the Cryostor‑suspended cells into labeled cryovials, place the vials in a CoolCell, and transfer to a –80 °C freezer for 18–24 hours before moving to a liquid‑nitrogen storage unit.
